title: 2 S. Koreans finish as runners-up at LPGA event on home soil
caption:
The BMW Ladies Championship ended in heartbreak for local favorites Ryu Hae-ran and Choi Hye-jin. Despite strong positions, both finished one stroke behind Japan’s Yuri Yoshida.

Source: Koreaherald - 2 S. Koreans finish as runners-up at LPGA event on home soil
